ghToken.description: GitHub Personal Access Token for cloning repos and creating PRs

defaultBudget.description: Default budget in USD per task (default: 15)

maxConcurrentTasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent coding tasks (default: 2)

envFile.description: Path to .env file with API keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY) passed to task processes

useSubscriptionAuth.description: When true, strip ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY from the task environment so Claude/Codex CLIs use subscription auth instead of API keys (default: false)
